queries.item: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ?:ab__mb_motivation_items ( motivation_item_id mediumint(8) unsigned NOT NULL auto_increment, storefront_id int(11) unsigned NOT NULL default 0, position smallint(5) unsigned NOT NULL default 0, expanded_desktop char(1) NOT NULL default 'Y', expanded_tablet char(1) NOT NULL default 'N', expanded_mobile char(1) NOT NULL default 'N', vendor_edit char(1) NOT NULL default 'Y', status char(1) NOT NULL default 'A', icon_type varchar(32) NOT NULL default '', icon_class varchar(64) NOT NULL default '', icon_color varchar(20) NOT NULL default '', exclude_categories char(1) NOT NULL default 'N', exclude_destinations char(1) NOT NULL default 'N', exclude_products char(1) NOT NULL default 'N', template_path text CHARACTER SET utf8, template_settings text CHARACTER SET utf8 NOT NULL, usergroup_ids varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', PRIMARY KEY (motivation_item_id, storefront_id), INDEX exc_categories (exclude_categories), INDEX exc_destinations (exclude_destinations), INDEX exc_products (exclude_products) ) DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ?:ab__mb_motivation_item_descriptions ( motivation_item_id mediumint(8) unsigned NOT NULL, lang_code char(2) NOT NULL default '', name varchar(255) NOT NULL default '', description mediumtext, PRIMARY KEY (motivation_item_id, lang_code) ) DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ?:ab__mb_motivation_item_objects ( motivation_item_id mediumint(8) unsigned NOT NULL, object_id mediumint(8) unsigned NOT NULL default '0', object_type char(1) NOT NULL default 'C', PRIMARY KEY (motivation_item_id, object_id, object_type), INDEX mid_otype (motivation_item_id, object_type) ) DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ?:ab__mb_vendors_descriptions ( motivation_item_id mediumint(8) unsigned NOT NULL, company_id int(11) unsigned NOT NULL default 0, lang_code char(2) NOT NULL default '', description mediumtext, status char(1) NOT NULL default 'A', PRIMARY KEY (motivation_item_id, company_id, lang_code) ) DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;
